minutes.title: Meeting Minutes - Remote Control Design
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed requirements and design options for a remote control, deciding to use conventional batteries and a single curved shape. Decisions were made on material choices and interface features, with tasks assigned for further research and development.
decisions: We will use conventional batteries instead of kinetic watch batteries due to cost and feasibility concerns.
The team agreed that the case could be made from plastic, rubber, or titanium. A single curved shape was suggested for easier joystick usage.
USB might be used for software interface on PC due to minimal design, but additional cost could push up overall unit price.

actions.task: Add pretty pictures to illustrate the design
Program the remote control using a software interface on a home computer
Research noise for remote control loss
